items.heading: Getting Rides to Dialysis
steps: Call the health plan using the number on the insurance card.
Explain that long bus trips and lack of a car have led to missed dialysis.
Request covered round-trip rides to dialysis.
Keep attending scheduled dialysis while rides are arranged.

items.heading: Getting Food
steps: Go to Manna Food Pantry on Mondays 1:00-3:00 PM at 1230 S Millard Ave.

items.heading: Weight and Blood Pressure Log
steps: Keep doing your daily weight and blood pressure log on paper and bring it to each session.

closing: Follow these steps to stay on track with your care plan.
